fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.help: The resource name of the Log Bucket that owns the Log Metric.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A description of this metric, which is used in documentation.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: If set to True, then this metric is disabled and it does not generate any points.

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: An advanced logs filter (https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/advanced-filters) which is used to match log entries.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The client-assigned metric identifier.

fields.label: Value Extractor
fields.help: A valueExtractor is required when using a distribution logs-based metric to extract the values to record from a log entry.

fields.label: Bucket Options
Explicit Buckets
fields.help: Specifies a set of buckets with arbitrary widths.

fields.label: Exponential Buckets
Growth Factor
fields.help: Must be greater than 1.

fields.label: Num Finite Buckets
fields.help: Must be greater than 0.

fields.label: Scale
fields.help: Must be greater than 0.
Specifies an exponential sequence of buckets that have a width that is proportional to the value of the lower bound.

fields.label: Linear Buckets
Num Finite Buckets
fields.help: Must be greater than 0.

fields.label: Offset
fields.help: Lower bound of the first bucket.

fields.label: Width
fields.help: Must be greater than 0.
Specifies a linear sequence of buckets that all have the same width (except overflow and underflow).
The bucketOptions are required when the logs-based metric is using a DISTRIBUTION value type and it describes the bucket boundaries used to create a histogram of the extracted values.

fields.label: Metric Descriptor
Display Name
fields.help: A concise name for the metric, which can be displayed in user interfaces.

fields.label: Metric Kind
fields.help: Whether the metric records instantaneous values, changes to a value, etc.

fields.label: Unit
fields.help: The unit in which the metric value is reported.

fields.label: Value Type
fields.help: Whether the measurement is an integer, a floating-point number, etc.

fields.label: Labels
Description
fields.help: A human-readable description for the label.

fields.label: Key
fields.help: The label key.

fields.label: Value Type
fields.help: The type of data that can be assigned to the label.
The set of labels that can be used to describe a specific instance of this metric type.
The optional metric descriptor associated with the logs-based metric.
